title: Image content
description: The `image` content block, carrying base64-encoded data and its MIME type.
question: Does an image result survive adaptation, or is it dropped or flattened to text?
notes: The two adapters built around multimodal model APIs pass images through; the two that flatten results to text or to structured data drop them. LangChain is unmeasured here: its audio conversion raises on the same result, so the call aborts before this block can be observed. Isolating it needs a fixture that returns one block at a time.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: the image block is dropped from the result.
notes_by_num.2: Mastra: all content blocks are dropped, images included.

verdict.headline: Delivered by two, dropped by two, unmeasured at one.
verdict.detail: A tool that returns a chart or a screenshot is only useful if the image reaches a model that can see it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: A dropped image block is a silent failure: the call succeeds, the result arrives, and the payload the tool existed to return is simply gone.
